decided: The archive's line naming files it commits from the change's folder that git never tracked does not name the saved brief, just as it does not name the archive's own record.
alternatives: name the saved brief like any other file git never tracked
why: The brief is the archive's own writing, saved by every archive, not work the change left behind. Naming it would put the line on every archive with a pull request, including archives that would otherwise show none; R-adf-13 ratified the line for files the work leaves behind, so showing it on every archive would go beyond what the user ratified under G0.
